'''Fourth Oath''' may refer to:
* The Oath of obedience to the [[Black Ajah Hunters]] sworn on the [[Oath Rod]] by the [[Ten ferrets]] and the uncovered [[Black]] sisters.
* A hypothetical Oath of loyalty to the Amyrlin on the Oath Rod considered by [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]. See [[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 16]].
* Personal oaths of fealty to [[Egwene al'Vere]] sworn by various [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] (not sworn on the Oath Rod but equally binding due to the [[First Oath]]).
